24. I have heard Ld. Counsel for the parties and have gone through the records as well as the as the case law cited by the parties.

25. As per the section 166(2) of M.V. Act, the application under section 166(1) can be filed at the option of the claimant, to the claim Tribunal having jurisdiction over the area in which:
 i) the accident occurred,
 ii) within whose jurisdiction the claimant/petitioner  resides,
 iii) within whose jurisdiction the claimant/petitioner  carries on his business, or  iv) within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the defendant resides.

26. It is important to note that section 21 CPC, which is referred and relied time and again by Hon'ble Supreme Court including in the case of Mantoo Sarkar (supra) and Malati Sardar (supra), relates to Ld. appellant and revisionist court and not to trial court.

Such section 21 bars, taking objection relating to territorial jurisdiction for the first time in the appellant court,
unless the same was taken at the earliest possible opportunity and further that there is a consequent failure of justice.
